card.name: Grade 4 severity wording and DRESS
card.fires_on: Punctuation or linking word right after 'Life-threatening consequences' in Grade 4 toxicity definitions, and the word 'with' in 'Drug Rash with Eosinophilia'. Also fires on 'urgent' just after that.

modes.label: Grade 4 definition
modes.description: The semicolon, colon or 'urgent' after 'Life-threatening consequences' in adverse-event grading text.
modes.example: Grade 4: Life-threatening consequences<<;>> urgent intervention indicated.

modes.label: DRESS expansion
modes.description: The word 'with' inside the spelled-out name Drug Rash with Eosinophilia and Systemic Symptoms.
modes.example: DRESS = Drug Rash<< with>> Eosinophilia and Systemic Symptoms

card.writes: It seems to suppress words like severity and duration, steering the next word away from them.
card.plain: It marks fixed phrases in severity grading and the DRESS name where the next words are already set.
